decisions.reason: The dietary supplement range is a core part of the firm's established pharmacy consumer health business and fits its strategy of broadening the consumer portfolio, so withdrawing the whole line is unlikely.
The skin and hair supplement sits in a popular pharmacy beauty-from-within segment within an established line and costs little to keep, even though it is no longer visible on the website.

The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche product with limited visibility, but immune products gained demand during the pandemic and require little investment, so the firm likely keeps it for now.

The OTC triptan is a differentiated pharmacy-only medicine with a regulatory approval behind it and steady self-medication demand, making it valuable to the consumer health portfolio despite being distant from the core offer.
